paragraphs: Abilis Solutions designs, implements and supports offender management systems for correctional agencies. The company says it has multiple implementations in corrections agencies across the United States, Canada and Australia.

Its system is modular and configurable, which the company presents as a way to avoid costly custom development. It counts over 40 integrated modules built to standards defined by the Corrections Technology Association. The architecture is described as secure and highly available, built on n-tier design and optimized for cloud deployment. Projects are said to reach go-live within 27 to 36 months. New software arrives three times a year on a fixed cadence shaped by customer-driven roadmaps.

The site reports users across more than 400 prisons and community offices. It also cites agencies in three countries. A customer group called the CORIS Community, introduced in 2015, was set up to share practices and help steer the product. Abilis supports that group with virtual sessions, workshops and periodic customer events.
